statements.impact_statement: CVE-2024-34069 only affects the Werkzeug interactive debugger, which is reachable only when the application runs with debug=True. ReportAudit starts the server with debug=False (app/servicio.py, line 64: app.run(host="127.0.0.1", port=config["servicio"]["puerto"], debug=False)) and never enables the debugger elsewhere, so the vulnerable code is not in the execution path. The dependency is upgraded anyway to werkzeug 3.1.9 by the Dependabot grouped security PR #23.
